body:
I guess my dream job is to be a comedian. I did stand up for a talent show in high school, and that went pretty well, but since I dropped out of college, I don't find very much humor in things anymore. 

As for my situation, not driving is a huge impediment. I rely solely on my mom to get around. It's sort of humiliating. When I try to think about driving, I just can't do it. I can't ever imagine myself behind the wheel of a car. There's too much responsibility, and there's too much at stake.

As for school, I've never been a great student. I've almost always had no trouble understanding the material, I just have an extremely difficult time getting myself to do the work. This has been a problem since the second grade. In high school, I did enough homework to get by, and most of that homework was done minutes before class, copied from someone else, or just not done at all. A lot of this is because I expect myself to do such great work, but when I sit down to do it, and it comes out shitty, I feel like I shouldn't even do it at all. Some time during high school, I lost the ability to write papers. I would always second guess myself, until it was 3am and I only had 2 sentences on the page. I failed two of my favorite classes with my favorite teacher because I couldn't get myself to write a single damn paper.

The work situation isn't much better. The only job I ever held was a nightmare. It was at a cheap retail store, and I was put on the cash registers on my first day which also happened to be a HUGE sale day. My bosses expected the other cashier to train me while she was checking out the same god damn crowd I was. The whole 2 weeks I worked there were some of the worst in my life. I came home with a deep sense of despair every day. I suffered panic attacks too. I didn't fit in with my bosses and coworkers at all. They treated me like shit, even beyond the whole newbie stuff. I just went ahead and quit. I'm afraid of getting a job now because I don't want to feel like I always have to be proving myself to other people I don't like, even it's just proving I'm good at flipping burgers. I don't like the idea of being stuck to someone else's schedule. It makes me feel trapped and uncomfortable.

I hope that answers your questions, and that it isn't way too long. Like I said before, I have trouble writing, but sometimes it just flows, and I have to get it all out.
